name: slot-text
title: Slot Text
description: Text that changes like a slot machine: each character spins through its own kind and brakes onto the new one.

perf.budget: One small text strip per character, moved by one transform; widths are measured once per character. Spin strips are dropped when the reels stop.

measurements.notes: Spikes are the first frame of a spin, when every reel lays out its strip of glyphs.

a11y.reducedMotion: The new text appears at once.
a11y.screenReader: Reads the whole text once; the reels are hidden.
